item: 6.6 Auto-include editor selection + Include open file (2026-10-10): the live pill, its per-message ×, the two paperclip SWITCH rows (selection ON / file OFF by default), the file label, the wire flag, the sent bubble, replay, queue and retry
branch: __selection {path,start,end,text} → ideSel; __selPref {on,file} → selIncluded / fileIncluded (#tglSel / #tglFile in #attachMenu's .popup-f footer, setTgl, the switch does NOT close the menu); activeSel(): selIncluded && text → the selection; else fileIncluded → {…, file:true} (label `File · file`, tooltip whole file + cursor line); else selIncluded → the cursor line; else null. The send adds selection{path,start,end,text[,file:true]} — the page never sends content; ChatPanel reads the buffer at send time and writes the <ide_opened_file … File content:> tag; SessionStore parses it back to selection{…, file:true}. A `· file` pill click bridges {kind:'open', path, line, select:false} (caret only); a selection pill bridges {…, endLine}.
provenance: Page-side contract only: the frames are OUR host frames (ChatPanel pushes __selection / __selPref; fixture-invented shapes match the Kotlin producer by construction, pinned by RenderLimitsTest's splice checks and the SessionStoreSelectionTest round trip). The CLI route was MEASURED DEAD 2026-10-10 on 2.1.296 over stdio: a VS Code-shaped selection_changed notification over the MCP-over-WS 'ide' client (fake bridge, 4 variants incl. after a first turn) never reached the model (answer NONE, no <ide_selection> in the transcript) — the hook lives in the TUI's React tree and the ideName gate (BXr) returns null for a plain 'ws' client. Negative control: on the pre-change build step 0's pill/menu asserts fail.
